content.title: Private credit secondaries volume nearly doubles to $20B in 2025 – Evercore
content.summary: The private credit secondaries market experienced another year of record growth, with transaction volume nearly doubling to $20 billion, from $10.9 billion in 2024, according to Evercore’s 2025 Credit Secondary Market Survey. The market’s rapid expansion mirrors the private credit market’s growth, but also reflects the elevated demand for exit opportunities from LPs in the normally illiquid asset class with long-term holds. content.title: The secondary market's capitalization conundrum
content.summary: Twice a year, some of the largest intermediaries in the secondary market publish data, based on a survey of buyers, outlining the volume of trade in fund stakes.
